EC1: Type 1 diabetes [OR], Secondary diabetes [OR], gestational diabetes
EC2: Ongoing dementia [AND] treatment [OR] or anti-depressive disorder medication
EC6: Underlying chronic liver disease (hemochromatosis [OR], liver cell carcinoma [OR], autoimmune liver disease [OR], liver cirrhosis [OR], chronic viral hepatitis)
EC7: Allergy [OR] or hypersensitivity [AND] to target medication or any of its components
EC8: Renal failure [OR], moderate [OR] or severe renal impairment  (estimated glomerular filtration rate < 30 mL/min/1.73 m2) [OR], or ongoing dialysis
EC9: Abnormal liver function (AST/ALT > x3 upper normal limit)
EC10: History of alcohol [OR] or drug abuse in the previous 3 months
EC11: Premenopausal women who are nursing [OR] or pregnant
EC12: Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) [OR] or human immunodeficiency virus (AIDS)
